<thought>To satisfy the tool’s requirement, I will query the template catalog using a single functional‑group criterion (the formation of an ether oxygen). This should return any templates that involve creating an ether, which may include the intramolecular Michael cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Once a template is found, I can retrieve its SMARTS and map the reaction to produce the required mapped_rxn.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
